reason: A is the better proposal because it extends prior Al-lightweighting results to the Mo-containing target alloy and directly tests the key phase-stability/mechanical-retention trade-off, whereas B largely reproduces the previously studied HfMoNbTiZr subtraction alloy. A’s claimed 10–15% density reduction and retention of ductility are optimistic given the limited substitution and reported Al-induced embrittlement, but these risks are experimentally testable.
